subject: Civil Engineer FIFO application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Doolee team,

I'm applying for the Civil Engineer FIFO role advertised on SEEK.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I designed road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, reviewing drawings, doing site inspections and quality checks, and coordinating workers, subcontractors and suppliers. I'm Melton based, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and I'm available for FIFO work.

Your advert mentions earthworks, roads, drainage and pavements on a 2/1 roster, which is the work I trained for. My cost estimating and quantities work so far is from study, and I haven't worked a FIFO roster yet.

Could we talk about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Application for Civil Engineer (FIFO)
paragraphs: I am applying for the Civil Engineer role on your FIFO 2/1 roster, advertised on SEEK. The advert describes work across earthworks, roads, drainage and pavements, from reading drawings and inspecting sites through to coordinating labour and materials, and that is the kind of civil delivery role I want to build my career in.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi and completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. In that course I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports and progress reports, and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to keep work moving.

I live in Melton, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027. I am available for FIFO work. My cost estimating and quantities experience is from coursework, and I have not yet worked a FIFO roster, so those are areas I would be learning with your team.
Thank you for considering my application. My portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
